requirements.requirement: There is a semi-autobiography whose plot centers around the protagonist's body part.
The semi-autobiography was initially published in its author's native language.
The semi-autobiography was later translated by a translator who is another award-winning writer, translator, and journalist.
The translator received a notable translation grant sometime between 2000 and 2020, inclusive.
The author of the semi-autobiography holds a PhD degree.
The author's MS dissertation earned the title of best dissertation between the years 2005 and 2010, inclusive.
The university where the author completed their master's degree was established on the 11th of August in a year between 1960 and 1990, inclusive.
Determine the author's real full name.
